Before forwarding, rewrite the request body by replacing every `ping` with `pong`, and fix Content-Length so the upstream receives the modified body (wrap Director; buffer and replace r.Body). tasks.reference_solution_sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
cd "$W"
cat > proxy.go <<'GOEOF'
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httputil"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"strconv"
)

func main() {
	u, _ := url.Parse(os.Getenv("UPSTREAM"))
	p := httputil.NewSingleHostReverseProxy(u)
	d := p.Director
	p.Director = func(r *http.Request) {
		d(r)
		if r.Body != nil {
			b, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
			r.Body.Close()
			nb := bytes.Replace(b, []byte("ping"), []byte("pong"), -1)
			r.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(nb))
			r.ContentLength = int64(len(nb))
			r.Header.Set("Content-Length", strconv.Itoa(len(nb)))
		}
	}
	http.ListenAndServe(os.Getenv("LISTEN"), p)
}
GOEOF
